title: AUTH-138 recovery removes old entity and controls

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given User A is authenticated as user-a in an isolated browser context

steps.title: Install clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 07:59:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
Pause clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 08:00:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"

assertionSteps.title: 2. And the selected fixture tab is labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page
3. And access A is expired; refresh R expires at controlled time T+600 seconds
4. And the dialog named "Your session has been expired" on the Home page is visible
5. And the relogin response removes ENTITY-A and its drawer
6. When User A clicks the button labelled "Extend" inside the dialog named "Your session has been expired"
7. And the fixture delivers the accepted recovery response without ENTITY-A
8. Then previous ENTITY-A application controls are absent from the portal; their component types and exact identities are UNVERIFIED
9. When User A clicks the icon button with test ID "${MFE_APP_PREFIX_STYLE}_avatar_IconButton" in the portal header on the Home page
10. And User A clicks the menu item containing "user-a" inside the menu with DOM ID "menu-appbar-avatar"
11. Then the text "user-a" is visible inside the dialog titled "User Profile" on the Home page
12. And the installed entities do not contain ENTITY-A

annotations.description: Actual MFE; controlled identity, catalog, API responses and browser time. Signed current-BFF validation is used only where declared. Synthetic credentials and user aliases; no real identity provider acceptance.

limits: The recorded assertions and environment binding limit the supported business result.
